in_marathi.name: Vidyut
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy, Knowledge, Electricity

vedic_reference.note: Vidyut is the name of the god of lightning and thunder in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word vidyut, meaning 'present lightning'. In the Rigveda, Vidyut is described as the god of the midday sun, and is often invoked during rituals to bring prosperity and good fortune.
